statements.label: I
statements.text: The primary $\mathrm{CO2}$ acceptor in $\mathrm{C4}$ plants is phosphoenolpyruvate and is found in the mesophyll cells.

statements.label: II
statements.text: Mesophyll cells of $\mathrm{C4}$ plants lack RuBisCo enzyme.

options_en.1: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options_en.2: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options_en.3: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
